notes: Root read every move-review, serious-candidate rationale, accepted context and audit field in the held candidate. All23moveIDs follow final publication order and explanations identify actual source-specific claims or qualifications.
No-tag reasoning distinguishes missing normative bridges from equivocation/circularity, treats explicit exceptions consistently, and preserves genuine choosing and instrumental sanctions.

All candidates concern defects already discussed in frozen critiques. Contexts use exact catalog labels and permitted lengths. Book allegations remain reported contextual disputes, and no excluded discussion, captions noise or external factual verification is imported.

Candidate acceptance is an independent reviewer judgment, not final tag authorization. The fresh anonymous adjudicator must test every accepted and rejected candidate against the precise definition; contested criteria, overgeneralization, incomplete replies and compressed language alone do not automatically establish a tag. Root did not supply labels, alter decisions, expose peer judgments or set a tag quota.
inputAccess: Controller inspected all preauthoring tool calls: literal plan and allowed reader only; full reading authenticated before authorship.
